name: prop-cabinet
about: An upright arcade cabinet for the hub: gloss black with chrome trim, a blank screen and marquee (the game draws its own picture and name on them), neon edge strips. Tripo v3.1 at its standard (low-credit) settings from concept prop-cabinet-sd-0, one attempt.
bar: the bar for a mid-sized prop: 1024 px colour, 512 px other maps
